articles.title: Capital B adds 376 Bitcoin in $29M purchase, boosting holdings to 3,521 BTC
articles.snippet: Capital B’s latest Bitcoin purchase was its largest in nearly a year, pushing the French company ahead of H100 Group among publicly traded BTC holders.

articles.title: Yen intervention meets US inflation data: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: This week’s CPI and PPI prints, along with the Fed’s Sept. 16 rate decision, could determine whether Bitcoin can secure $80,000 as a support level.

articles.title: Philippines eyes payment operator registration freeze, tighter VASP checks
articles.snippet: A central bank proposal would pause new payment operator registrations while requiring enhanced monitoring and transaction limits for arrangements involving virtual asset firms.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

articles.title: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective
articles.snippet: The mortgage lender plans to bring more than $10 billion in historical loans onchain, turning thousands of mortgage files into blockchain-based records.
